import paramiko
import jwt
import time
# Supabase JWT Secret
jwt_secret = 'Sup3baseJWTSecret-1491137-LongEnough'
# Generate anon key (short-lived, public)
anon_payload = {
    'role': 'anon',
    'iat': int(time.time()),
    'exp': int(time.time()) + 31536000  # 1 year
}
anon_key = jwt.encode(anon_payload, jwt_secret, algorithm='HS256')
# Generate service role key (long-lived, admin)
service_payload = {
    'role': 'service_role',
    'iat': int(time.time()),
    'exp': int(time.time()) + 31536000
}
service_key = jwt.encode(service_payload, jwt_secret, algorithm='HS256')
print('ANON_KEY=' + anon_key)
print('SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=' + service_key)
# Now connect to VPS and update the .env file

# Create the new .env content

SUPABASE_URL=https://arelorian.de
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://arelorian.de
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=%s
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=%s
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=%s
SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET=%s
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:Sup3base-1491137-Strong!@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable
DIRECT_URL=postgres://postgres:Sup3base-1491137-Strong!@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable

REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
# Node Configuration
PORT=3000
NODE_ENV=production
# Game Configuration
ARE_MODE=shader
PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=auto
SUPABASE_AUTH=true
''' % (anon_key, anon_key, service_key, jwt_secret)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cat /root/opt/areloria/.env')
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
